blocks.text: Gold moves: Open new session while no session is live; with a live session Save takes gold and a banner "The current session lives under Rooms. Open" appears. The typed time is converted to UTC in the browser. Renaming the club renames its engine organisation too: the engine is told first, and if it refuses, the old name stays in cab as well. Format, language and audience are part of the club profile: the club head keeps them here, the club page and the directory show them, and the public club API carries them for any service that lists clubs.
